s.note: Lime-cured prawns with red onion and coriander on crisp tostadas with avocado
s.how: Dice 400g green prawns and cover with the juice of 4 limes for 20 minutes until opaque. Drain and toss with diced red onion and coriander. Spread smashed avocado on crisp corn tostadas and pile the prawns on top just before serving.

s.note: Plantain chips, peanut chilli lime dip. Shuri grows the herb back
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and slice very thin. Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden, then salt well. Whisk 4 tbsp peanut butter with warm water, a pinch of chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime to a smooth dip and serve alongside.

m.note: Achiote pork in banana leaf, roasted 4 hours, in tortillas. Namor's people are Maya
m.how: Blend achiote paste with the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes and rub over 1.5kg pork shoulder. Wrap in banana leaves and roast covered at 150C for 4 hours until it falls apart. Shred and serve in corn tortillas with lime-pickled red onion.

w.note: His people call him K'uk'ulkan. Coconut caramel flan
w.how: Melt 150g sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a 20cm round dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml coconut milk, 395g condensed milk and 1 tsp vanilla, then pour over the caramel. Sit the dish in a roasting tin of hot water and bake at 160C for 50 minutes until just set. Chill overnight, run a knife round the edge and turn out. Top with toasted coconut and lime zest.

d.n: Talokan coconut and lime agua fresca
d.note: Coconut and lime over ice, from a city hidden for centuries
d.how: Blend 1L coconut water, 100g shredded fresh or desiccated coconut, the juice of 3 limes and 3 tbsp caster sugar until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve, pressing hard. Chill for 1 hour. Pour into 4 glasses filled with ice and garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.
